[[File:SlaveShip-MSW91.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Nagai transport being loaded with Wookiees.]]
'''Transports''' were used by the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ozrei N'takkilomandrife]] used these craft in an effort to restart the [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement trade]] on Kashyyyk, loading captive [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] aboard the ships. When [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] traveled to Kashyyyk to meet with Chewbacca's family, they uncovered the slave trade and [[Skirmish on Kashyyyk (Nagai invasion)|prevented]] the slave ships from leaving the planet.
